# Product video hooks: write the first 3 seconds of TikTok and Meta ads

**A product and the buyer's own words become 3-second hooks: matching visual, spoken line and text overlay, checked for claims.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_45312c879c64.webp" alt="A hand slams a steel water bottle onto a wooden table at sunset, water bursts out and a crushed plastic bottle rolls away." width="480"></p>

Turn a product into scroll-stopping video hooks. Writes the first 3 seconds of TikTok, Reels and Meta product videos as three agreeing layers (what is on screen, the spoken line, the text overlay), from the buyer's own words, across 20+ hook types taken from Meta's Hooks Menu, Motion's 2026 hook data, Hormozi's callouts and the TikTok openers that spread in 2026 (late discovery, compliment then reveal, problem and fix in one clip, reply to a comment). It matches each hook to the buyer's awareness, checks it against platform claim rules, and, when footage exists, makes one MP4 per hook for testing. Use when someone asks for hooks, openers, the first 3 seconds, a better intro, or new hook variants for a product video or ad. NOT for whole ad plans (use ecommerce-video-ads), generating a viral-style product-in-use hook clip from photos (use varg-product-hook), app or SaaS hooks, or YouTube titles and thumbnails.

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill product-video-hooks                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills product-video-hooks --agent github-copilot --scope user

```
